'''Soovada''', translating from [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] as '''Spoils of War''', was an [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] celebration of total extravagance in [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] culture, originally celebrated in the [[Summer/Legends|summer]] [[Season/Legends|season]] of [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] after successful military campaigns. An event held on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] popularized the holiday among outside cultures, and by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] it was celebrated on hundreds of worlds across the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]], while its historical origin lost its significance.<ref name="codex" />

During the event, rival clans competed to prove their superior wealth, attempting to sponsor the most parties, pit fights, bounties, [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] on [[Slot machine/Legends|slot machines]], and every other public display of fortune and excess.<ref name="codex" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Soovada first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The celebration was a world event which ran through the summer of [[2014]], from [[June 10]] to [[August 19]].
